name: istoque-e2e
description: Testes e2e do Is.toque com Playwright (padrão GAC).

scripts.local:administrador:test:chrome:headless: cross-env ENV=local HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --project=administrador-chromium --workers=1
scripts.local:gerente:test:chrome:headless: cross-env ENV=local HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --project=gerente-chromium --workers=1
scripts.local:funcionario:test:chrome:headless: cross-env ENV=local HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --project=funcionario-chromium --workers=1
scripts.local:dev:test:chrome:headless: cross-env ENV=local HEADLESS=true npx playwright test --project=administrador-chromium --project=gerente-chromium --project=funcionario-chromium --workers=1

comentarios_scripts.script:test: roda todos os papéis em todos os navegadores
comentarios_scripts.script:papel:test:chrome: roda só o Chromium de um papel, abrindo a janela
comentarios_scripts.script:papel:test:chrome:headless: igual ao anterior, sem abrir a janela
comentarios_scripts.novoPapel: adicionar em config/usuarios.js, global/global-setup.js, playwright.config.js e criar os scripts local:{papel}:test:chrome
